mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies and 30 degree temperatures near Harriet Park. With a Full Moon tonight, the overnight low will hit 27 degrees with no rain predicted.

City news today focuses on tax season. Property tax bills are being mailed out no later than December 15. You can pay your taxes through the City of Verona website using credit cards or electronic checks, or by utilizing the 24/7 drop boxes located at the City Center building.

There is plenty to do in town. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found an unresponsive driver, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Stop by for today's flavor of the day, which is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. We are open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to enjoy a scoop before we close for the night.
